issue.title: Properly reset mocks
issue.body:
When we moved to the inline mocks, clearing
the mocks was done incorrectly.

- Fixes: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/47179

body:
You are right!

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/47181 fixes the issue
Thank you very much for the quick resolution 😄
Will this be fixed for the 3.20 LTS version?

@ppetrovt that's the plan. But could you test 3.21.2 to check if everything is good for you?

That would help us being more confident about the backports.
@gsmet I can confirm it works fine with Quarkus 3.21.2.
@gsmet I've also tested it with 3.21.2 and can confirm that it works.
